description: This file is a large Bash shell script primarily designed to manage Remote Feature Control (RFC) for a set-top box or similar device. It includes functions for fetching and setting configuration parameters, communicating with a remote server via HTTP(S), processing JSON responses, managing reboots, and controlling device features dynamically. The script loads various device-specific properties, manages retries for network requests, and handles secure communication with support for MTLS and Codebig. It appears to be a core component for device configuration updates and feature toggling based on server-provided data.

methods.name: rfcLogging
methods.description: Logs messages with timestamp to RFC log file.

methods.name: tlsLog
methods.description: Logs TLS-related errors.

methods.name: eventSender
methods.description: Sends an event via IARM event sender if available.

methods.name: IsDirectBlocked
methods.description: Checks if direct network connection is blocked due to previous failures.

methods.name: IsCodeBigBlocked
methods.description: Checks if CodeBig network connection is blocked due to previous failures.

methods.name: getECMMacAddress
methods.description: Retrieves ECM MAC address and formats it.

methods.name: getFWVersion
methods.description: Fetches firmware version from version.txt or relevant source.

methods.name: getSerialNum
methods.description: Gets serial number of device.

methods.name: getBuildType
methods.description: Returns build type (e.g., prod, dev).

methods.name: getControllerId
methods.description: Returns controller ID (hardcoded to 2504).

methods.name: getChannelMapId
methods.description: Returns channel map ID (hardcoded).

methods.name: getVODId
methods.description: Returns VOD ID.

methods.name: rfcGet
methods.description: Retrieves value of specified RFC parameter.

methods.name: rfcSet
methods.description: Sets value for specified RFC parameter.

methods.name: preProcessFile
methods.description: Prepares and formats JSON data for parsing.

methods.name: getFeatures
methods.description: Parses processed JSON to extract feature enablement states.

methods.name: featureReport
methods.description: Prepares feature data report.

methods.name: getValidDataForRetry
methods.description: Extracts valid account and partner IDs from JSON for retries.

methods.name: rfcGetHashAndTime
methods.description: Retrieve stored hash and timestamp for config set.

methods.name: rfcSetHTValue
methods.description: Stores hash and timestamp for configuration set.

methods.name: rfcSetHashAndTime
methods.description: Updates hash and timestamp after successful config.

methods.name: rfcClearHashAndTime
methods.description: Clears hash and timestamp info.

methods.name: rfcStashStoreParams
methods.description: Stores persistent device parameters.

methods.name: rfcStashRetrieveParams
methods.description: Restores stored device parameters.

methods.name: rfcVideoGetAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves account ID for video device logic.

methods.name: rfcVideoCheckAccoutId
methods.description: Checks if account ID has changed for video device scenario.

methods.name: waitForIpAcquisition
methods.description: Waits until device has obtained a valid IP address.

methods.name: sendHttpRequest
methods.description: Performs HTTP request to fetch RFC configuration.

methods.name: sendHttpCBRequest
methods.description: Performs Codebig HTTP request with retries.

methods.name: sendHttpDirectRequest
methods.description: Performs direct network HTTP request with retries.

methods.name: checkCodebigAccess
methods.description: Checks if Codebig access is available.

methods.name: CallXconf
methods.description: Initiates connection to Xconf server for configuration update.
